rollback.compatibility_boundary: If newly added reference annotation fields have been written, the original b36 image can read preserved reports but may reject a later save of these fields. Preserve data and prefer a forward fix; do not claim full feature parity or restore/rewrite the database.
rollback.compatibility_boundary_zh: 若新版本已保存新增的 Reference 引用注释字段，旧 b36 镜像仍可读取保留的报告，但再次保存这些字段时可能返回 422。优先保留数据并向前修复；镜像回滚不代表旧版支持全部新增功能，不删除新 JSON 字段，也不恢复或改写数据库。
rollback.rollback_instruction: 排除后续发布后只回退完整基线 Compose 与固定镜像；保留实测既有结构、019记录及全部业务数据，不 downgrade 或恢复旧库。
